Arishfa Khan's Continued Arguments

The drama in episode 59 escalated as Arishfa Khan kept up her verbal altercation with Yung DSA. Yung confronted her regarding the inappropriate remark she directed at Amrapali Dubey.

Scout also entered the dispute, leading to personal remarks about height before other contestants like Qazi Touqeer and Mahhi Vij observed the shifting group dynamics.

Kitchen Clash Over Dietary Practices

Tensions moved to the kitchen area when Arishfa handled common cooking ingredients with unwashed hands after handling eggs. Amrapali Dubey, who follows a strict vegetarian diet, took serious offense to the action.

Manish Goel backed Amrapali's concern and asked Arishfa to maintain proper hygiene. Rather than offering an apology, Arishfa defended her actions by claiming others behaved similarly.

Hygiene Debates and Washroom Discussion

The argument widened when Arishfa brought up Love Gill's bathroom habits while speaking with Mahhi Vij. This disclosure prompted Amrapali, Mahhi, and Love to confront Arishfa about her prolonged time in the washroom.

While the female contestants debated the privacy boundaries, male housemates noted that the conversation was transpiring on national television, leading Kanika Mann to distance herself from the dispute.

Yung DSA and Love Gill Fallout

Later during the night, an accidental conversational mix-up occurred when Love Gill inadvertently began speaking to Yung DSA before cutting herself short.

Feeling disrespected, Yung walked away from the interaction, asserting his self-respect while Scout commented further on the strained communication between them.

Emotional Audio Messages From Loved Ones

The atmosphere shifted dramatically when Bigg Boss gathered the housemates in the garden to announce a special task involving family audio messages.

Contestants stepping onto the podium faced choices that required them to forfeit a personal lifeline if they decided to secure a loved one's voice note for another housemate.

Sacrifices and Surprises on the Podium

Manish Goel went first and selflessly assigned Qazi Touqeer's family message to Qazi, though Qazi initially viewed the gesture with skepticism before growing emotional upon hearing his parents and receiving a photo frame.

In subsequent rounds, Gullu chose to give up his lifeline so Kanika Mann could hear her father's supportive words, and Yung DSA handled the family voice note designated for Uditi Singh.

News Overview

Episode 59 of Bigg Boss 20 featured intense conflicts among Arishfa Khan, Amrapali Dubey, and Yung DSA regarding kitchen hygiene and personal remarks. The episode concluded on an emotional note as contestants sacrificed their lifelines to share heartfelt audio messages from their families.

ld.articleBody:
Discovery of the Body

A 28-year-old man was discovered dead inside a locked private lodge room situated in the Tirupattur district of Tamil Nadu. Staff members at the facility became concerned after receiving no response from the second-floor occupant and noticing a strange odor emanating from the accommodation.

Authorities were immediately summoned to the scene to handle the situation. Emergency responders and police officers had to force their way into the chamber to investigate the unresponsive guest.

Background and Departure

The deceased was identified as Selvaraj, the son of Shankar and a resident of Jayapuram Junction near Kathirimangalam. He had departed from his home several days prior, specifically informing his family that he was traveling to take up employment at a private company located in Hosur.

Instead of making the intended journey to Hosur, however, the victim checked into a private lodge positioned opposite the taluk office in Tirupattur. This location was situated merely two kilometers away from his actual residence.

Lodge Stay Details

During his check-in procedure, the guest informed the facility personnel that he needed a room to stay until Saturday. He explained to the staff that he was required to travel out of town in order to attend a relative's wedding ceremony.

When the scheduled departure day arrived, employees approached his second-floor door to verify if he was checking out. Finding the door bolted from the inside and detecting an unusual smell, they escalated the matter to local law enforcement.

Evidence at the Scene

Police personnel arrived at the lodge alongside members of the fire and rescue services to break open the locked entrance. Upon entering, they found the victim lying lifeless on the bed.

Investigators also reportedly uncovered liquor bottles and various snacks scattered inside the room. The remains were subsequently recovered and transported for formal medical examination.

Medical Examination and Family Reaction

The body was sent to the Tirupattur Government Medical College Hospital to undergo a postmortem examination. Authorities expect that the official autopsy report will reveal the exact cause of death.

Family members were promptly informed of the tragedy and rushed to the hospital facility. Relatives were visibly devastated, breaking down in grief upon seeing the victim's remains.

Family Suspicions and Police Investigation

The victim's mother, Sangeetha, formally approached the police department to lodge a complaint regarding the incident. She voiced strong suspicions surrounding the nature of her son's passing and called for a detailed inquiry.

Law enforcement officials have registered an official case and are examining the sequence of events from multiple perspectives. Investigators are currently working to determine why the victim stayed close to home instead of heading to Hosur as planned.

ld.articleBody:
Director Addresses Potential Third Installment

Filmmaker Danny Boyle has opened up about the potential continuation of the horror franchise, shedding light on plans for a third picture. While speaking at the Deadline Contenders event, the director shared insights into the creative direction of the planned project.

Although the production has not received official confirmation to move forward, Boyle's recent remarks give fans a clear look at what the creative team envisions for the unfolding narrative.

Praise for Alex Garland's Screenplay

Boyle expressed strong enthusiasm for the writing craft of Alex Garland, who penned the screenplay for the upcoming chapter. The director described the written material as fantastic, emphasizing the high quality of the narrative structure.

Securing the necessary financial backing remains the primary hurdle for the team. Once funding is locked in, the project will be in a position to take its next steps toward realization.

Cillian Murphy's Potential Comeback

The update also touched upon the possible return of actor Cillian Murphy to the franchise. When asked if the actor would reprise his role, Boyle confirmed that he is definitely open to the idea.

Boyle further commended the character arc crafted specifically for Murphy by Garland, labeling the part as fantastic. This positive indicator suggests that the actor's involvement could become a cornerstone of the third movie.

Connection to Earlier Films

Murphy originally stepped into the shoes of character Jim in the 2002 horror feature 28 Days Later. Furthermore, a surprise appearance by his character at the conclusion of The Bone Temple laid the groundwork for a much larger narrative presence going forward.

The combination of these plot developments points toward a substantial continuation of Jim's journey within the overarching timeline of the series.

Tying the Story Together

Addressing the broader plot of the proposed sequel, Boyle indicated that it would neatly unify the disparate threads of the overarching saga. He noted that the third film is designed to complete the tale in a mathematically perfect way where the circle closes.

This narrative ambition aims to deliver a satisfying conclusion to the cinematic universe established decades ago, bringing every major story element to a harmonious resolution.

Waiting on Production Greenlight

Despite the encouraging status report, the venture still lacks formal production confirmation from studio executives. Boyle concluded his statements by expressing optimism that all necessary components will eventually align.

Fans of the franchise must wait for further announcements as the creative team works through the logistics required to bring the final piece of the trilogy to life.

While funding and formal production confirmation are still pending, the director envisions the sequel as a perfect narrative conclusion that closes the circle on the horror franchise.

Global Premiere in Los Angeles

The much-anticipated mythological epic Ramayana: Rise of a Legend celebrated its grand worldwide debut in Los Angeles, drawing immense attention from fans and media alike. The main cast members gathered to launch the project internationally through an exclusive red carpet event.

Attendees and admirers caught the very first glimpses of the ambitious project during this major introductory phase held abroad.

Red Carpet Appearances by the Lead Stars

Ranbir Kapoor arrived at the venue dressed in a sparkling silver bandhgala while greeting supporters outside. Yash stepped onto the carpet alongside his wife Radhika Pandit, wearing a dark outfit paired with sunglasses and a detailed brooch, while Radhika wore a green and gold silk saree.

Sai Pallavi completed the main trio's look by opting for a red zardosi saree with detailed embroidery, keeping her styling simple and traditional.

Venue and Screening Details

The special 3D presentation took place at the David Geffen Theatre, situated within the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures. This initial viewing was strictly restricted to invited guests.

Social media feeds featured packed screening rooms filled with both domestic and international attendees waiting to witness the footage.

Notable Attendees and Interactions

Beyond the primary cast and crew, several notable figures from the entertainment industry joined the festivities. Jada Pinkett Smith, Rohini Iyer, Benji Kelly, and Gisella Marengo were among those spotted at the gathering.

Highlights from the red carpet included a warm embrace shared between Ranbir Kapoor and Yash in front of photographers.

Production Background and Creative Team

Nitesh Tiwari serves as the director of the film, with Namit Malhotra taking on production duties. The narrative adapts the classic ancient Indian epic for modern cinema audiences.

The central plot centers on the exile of Rama, the abduction of Sita by Ravana, and the subsequent confrontation representing the victory of righteousness over malevolence.

Cast and Release Schedule

The extensive star-studded cast features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. Additional supporting performers include Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta.

The theatrical rollout is scheduled globally for October 5, followed by paid preview screenings starting on November 4.

The primary cast of Ramayana: Rise of a Legend attended an exclusive invite-only global premiere in Los Angeles. The event featured red carpet appearances by the lead actors alongside international celebrities prior to the film's upcoming theatrical release.

ld.articleBody:
An Emotional Festival Message

Bollywood actress Celina Jaitly marked the festival of Diwali with a deeply emotional message shared on social media. The star expressed profound sorrow over being separated from her three sons during the holiday period.

The heartfelt post highlighted the emotional toll of distance and ongoing family disputes. Celina noted that this marked the second year she had to celebrate the festive season apart from her children.

Custody Dispute and Separation

The actress's three sons—Winston, Viraaj, and Arthur—currently reside in Austria. They are staying with their father, Austrian hotelier Peter Haag.

The separation stems from an ongoing divorce and custody battle between the couple. The distance has placed significant emotional strain on the family dynamics.

Fears Over Young Hearts

In her social media message, Celina voiced her primary concern regarding her children. She admitted it breaks her heart to imagine her young sons carrying so much pain.

She also expressed a deep fear that the children might feel pressured to take sides. Furthermore, she worried they might eventually forget her maternal love amid external influences.

Gratitude Amid Conflict

Despite the bitter circumstances of the divorce proceedings, Celina extended a measure of gratitude toward Peter Haag. She acknowledged his role in welcoming their children into the world.

The actress emphasized that she harbors no regrets about their past family creation. She hopes that the hurt causing their family to break apart will not diminish her sons' kindness.

Reassuring Her Children

Celina took the opportunity to directly address her boys through her public statement. She assured them that she has never left them in spirit and never asked them to choose sides.

She reminded the boys that nothing can ever erase the life they shared together. Their memory and the hope for a future together serve as her primary motivation to keep going.

Explaining some of her recent choices, the actress stated she had no alternative path. She felt compelled to safeguard whatever little resources remained for the future of her children.

Her actions, according to her statement, are entirely motivated by the long-term well-being of Winston, Viraaj, and Arthur.

ld.articleBody:
Third Weekend Performance

The theatrical run of Nitesh Tiwari's directorial venture continues to exhibit resilience as it entered its third weekend. Despite normal cooling trends in daily ticket sales during weekdays, the feature managed to draw significant crowds over the weekend period, adding roughly Rs 63 crore to its cumulative domestic tally.

Trade trackers note that this sustained weekend growth keeps the production on a steady trajectory. It now stands on the threshold of crossing the monumental Rs 1,000-crore nett milestone within the domestic market, reflecting long-term audience engagement.

Day 18 Collections And Language Breakdown

On its eighteenth day in cinemas, the cinematic adaptation pulled in Rs 35.60 crore nett across a total of 16,270 screenings nationwide. The Hindi-language version remained the primary driver of these earnings, bringing in Rs 26.25 crore from 13,850 shows.

Regional versions also contributed steadily to the overall figures on the same day. The Malayalam variant accounted for Rs 3.40 crore across 869 shows, the Kannada version collected Rs 2.50 crore from 449 shows, the Tamil print earned Rs 2.40 crore from 645 shows, and the Telugu edition added Rs 1.05 crore across 457 shows.

Cumulative Earnings Overview

With the latest figures factored in, the total domestic nett collection for the epic reached Rs 942.75 crore by the conclusion of its eighteenth day. This brings its domestic gross to Rs 1,126.50 crore.

On the international front, overseas gross earnings stand at Rs 567 crore. Combined with domestic revenues, the worldwide gross collection has climbed to an impressive Rs 1,693.50 crore, putting the Rs 1,700-crore milestone well within reach.

Record-Breaking Opening And Early Momentum

The project's success was preceded by immense pre-release buzz, underscored by advance ticket sales opening fifteen days prior to its premiere on Dussehra. By the time it debuted on November 5, 2026, it had already generated worldwide advance bookings valued at around Rs 200 crore.

Upon release, it opened to Rs 64.85 crore nett in India, marking the fourth-largest opening day in the history of Bollywood. Strong weekday numbers followed, including Rs 107 crore nett on Monday and Rs 94 crore nett on Tuesday, helping the film easily surpass the Rs 500-crore mark by the end of its first week.

Cast And Creative Team

Helmed by director Nitesh Tiwari, the feature is structured as a two-part cinematic adaptation of the traditional Indian epic. The principal cast features Ranbir Kapoor in the role of Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita, and Yash portraying Ravana.

The ensemble further features Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, Rakul Preet Singh as Surpanakha, Lara Dutta as Queen Kaikeyi, Arun Govil as King Dashrath, and Kajal Aggarwal as Mandodari. The production is backed by Namit Malhotra and Yash under Prime Focus Studios and Monster Mind Creations, featuring visual effects by DNEG and ReDefine, along with an original score by Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman.

Future Releases

The first part of the project launched globally as Ramayana: Part 1, also known internationally as Ramayana: Rise of a Legend. Its theatrical run has capitalized heavily on both festive timing and a multi-language rollout.

Alongside the ongoing box-office run of the first instalment, the creative team has confirmed updates regarding the sequel. Ramayana: Part 2 is officially slated to arrive in theatres during Diwali 2028.

ld.articleBody:
Tragic Passing of a Cinematic Visionary

The global film community is mourning the sudden loss of Sebastián Lelio, the celebrated director who made history for his home country. Lelio passed away at the age of 52 at his residence in Las Condes, Santiago, as confirmed by local reporting and a family statement.

His relatives shared the news through an Instagram post on partner Amalia Kassai's account, noting that the filmmaker died due to undisclosed health reasons. The family has requested privacy and respect as they navigate this profound sorrow.

Making Academy Awards History for Chile

Lelio achieved a monumental milestone in 2018 when his acclaimed feature A Fantastic Woman secured the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film. This victory marked the first time a Chilean production claimed the prestigious category, putting his nation's cinema firmly on the global map.

The movie was widely praised for its deeply humanistic storytelling, following a transgender woman named Marina as she dealt with grief and societal prejudice following the unexpected death of her partner.

A Master of Intimate Character Studies

Throughout his life, Lelio established himself as a multi-talented force who worked as a director, writer, editor, and producer. His filmography consistently spotlighted resilient women and the multifaceted trials of womanhood with striking empathy.

His creative reach extended across various genres and cultural landscapes, capturing complex emotional landscapes with remarkable visual and narrative sensitivity.

Exploration of Forbidden Love and Faith

Following his Oscar triumph, Lelio directed Disobedience in 2018, which featured standout performances from Rachel McAdams and Rachel Weisz. The film explored the intense and heartbreaking dynamics of a forbidden romance within an Orthodox Jewish community.

He later helmed the 2022 psychological drama The Wonder, starring Florence Pugh. This darker project examined themes of religious fanaticism, faith, and familial bonds in a thought-provoking historical setting.

A Rich and Diverse Filmography

Lelio's impressive oeuvre spanned numerous celebrated titles from earlier in his career, including Navidad and The Year Of The Tiger. He also directed Gloria Bell, which featured a stellar lead performance by Julianne Moore.

Among his more recent projects was The Wave, a festival favorite musical focusing on women participating in protests within his native Chile.

Unfinished Projects and Enduring Legacy

At the time of his death, the director was actively developing his tenth feature film, an adaptation of Alejandro Zambra's novel Chilean Poet. The source material centers on a frustrated writer navigating the complexities of romance and separation.

While his sudden passing cuts short a brilliant career that held many more stories, Lelio leaves behind a profound cinematic legacy as a national trailblazer and a dedicated champion of artistic expression.

ld.articleBody:
The Grand Launch in Hyderabad

Tollywood star Siddhu Jonnalagadda is preparing to captivate audiences once again as he embarks on a fresh romantic journey. Teaming up with newcomer filmmaker Mohan B, the actor officially commenced work on his upcoming venture, tentatively referred to as ‘Siddhu10’.

The ceremonial launch took place at the iconic Annapurna Studios in Hyderabad. The team marked the beginning of production with a traditional pooja ceremony, drawing significant attention from fans and industry insiders alike as anticipation builds for the upcoming feature.

Star-Studded Launch Event

Several notable figures from the Telugu film industry stepped out to show their support and grace the auspicious opening event. Producer Allu Aravind was among the prominent names spotted at the studio grounds in Hyderabad.

In addition to Allu Aravind, a host of esteemed directors attended the celebration. Filmmakers Nandini Reddy, Chandoo Mondeti, Harish Shankar, and Buchi Babu Sana were present to bless the team and celebrate the commencement of the project.

Cast and Production Details

The makers have officially cast Nayan Sarika as the female lead opposite Siddhu Jonnalagadda. Nayan brings previous acting experience from projects such as ‘Aay’, ‘KA’, ‘Gam Gam Ganesha’, and ‘Vishnu Vinayasam’.

While specific plot lines remain under wraps, the production team has described the venture as a beautiful love story. The film is being jointly produced by Sukumar Writings and Bunny Vas Works, with Thabitha Sukumar attached as the presenter.

Strong Technical Lineup

A seasoned technical crew has been assembled to support the debutant director. GV Prakash Kumar has been brought on board to compose the musical score for the romantic entertainer.

Rounding out the core technical team are cinematographer Chandru Selvaraj and production designer Sahi Suresh. This blend of fresh directorial vision and veteran technical expertise aims to deliver a polished cinematic experience.

Context of Past Successes

Siddhu Jonnalagadda enters this romantic project following a mix of commercial milestones and hurdles in his career. His 2024 venture ‘Tillu Square’, co-starring Anupama Parameswaran, emerged as a massive box-office hit, grossing Rs 126.75 crore worldwide according to Sacnilk.

That global total included Rs 83.39 crore net in India alongside approximately Rs 30 crore from overseas territories. However, his subsequent theatrical releases, including ‘Jack’ and ‘Telusu Kada’, did not match the historic commercial heights achieved by ‘Tillu Square’.

Looking Ahead to Production

With the formal launch ceremonies successfully concluded, the creative team has announced that regular principal photography will commence shortly. The makers intend to move swiftly from pre-production into active shooting phases.

As the actor looks to return to the spotlight with a pure romantic genre, fans eagerly await further announcements concerning the official title and theatrical release windows for the project.

ld.articleBody:
Stepping Away From 007's Martini

Callum Turner temporarily traded the iconic spy's signature beverage for a flute of blended Scotch whisky during a recent commercial shoot in New York City. The 36-year-old actor was photographed working outside Yves French Bistro while surrounded by gift bags for Johnnie Walker Blue Label.

Dressed smartly in a fur-collared leather jacket, Turner appeared relaxed despite the heavy workload of balancing multiple international projects. The commercial appearance follows a whirlwind trip back to the United Kingdom to complete screen tests at Berkshire's Bray studios.

Juggling International Film Projects

While maintaining momentum in the high-profile race to secure the next James Bond franchise lead, Turner has also remained dedicated to his acting commitments in the United States. The busy star has been actively shooting scenes for his romantic comedy project titled One Night Only in New York.

Industry observers have noted that Turner appears to be actively clearing his professional calendar to accommodate a potential multi-year commitment to Amazon MGM Studios. His frantic schedule highlights just how seriously the British performer is taking the current career milestone.

Stepping Down From Production Venture

Further fueling speculation that a major franchise announcement is imminent, official corporate filings show Turner has recently resigned from his executive post at Twentytwe Films Ltd. He originally launched the production company alongside his pop star wife Dua Lipa with equal shares.

The enterprise was established to develop television and film projects modeled after Margot Robbie's successful LuckyChap production banner. Stepping back from leadership duties strongly suggests the actor is preparing for the massive time constraints of leading a major global action franchise.

Fierce Competition for the Franchise

Turner is far from the only high-profile British actor contending for the coveted role of James Bond, facing stiff competition from several critically acclaimed peers. Jack Lowden and Josh O'Connor both participated in rigorous screen tests alongside Turner in London last month.

Recent reports also indicate that Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult entered the fray as late surprise contenders for the part. Both actors have previously portrayed major comic book icons for DC Studios as Batman and Lex Luthor respectively.

Rumors and Pub Slips

Speculation reached a fever pitch last week when rumors suggested that Josh O'Connor had already secured the iconic role after navigating final negotiations with studio executives. The gossip reportedly originated after a castmate from O'Connor's London play let details slip during celebratory drinks.

According to sources, a fellow cast member from the production of Golden Boy shared the casting news with patrons at a Soho pub following the show's Halloween closing night. While the pub chatter sparked widespread debate, official studio confirmation remains pending.

Shifting Betting Odds and Future Timelines

Bookmakers have continued to adjust their odds dynamically as the casting process moves through its final stages with Amazon MGM Studios. Turner has maintained a strong position at the top of the betting markets, while Robert Pattinson and Josh O'Connor have also seen their odds shorten significantly.

Industry analysts anticipate that if studio executives successfully finalize the casting process by December, production on the next installment in the legendary cinematic franchise could officially commence sometime in 2027.

ld.articleBody:
A Historic Milestone

The cinematic landscape of Kollywood has witnessed a monumental achievement as Jailer 2 officially claims the title of the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and starring superstar Rajinikanth, the action-packed sequel achieved this historic feat within a mere 11 days of its theatrical run. Surpassing previous benchmarks set by long-standing blockbusters, the movie has successfully crossed the unprecedented ₹700-crore threshold globally.

Box Office Momentum

Industry analysts note that the momentum for the Sun Pictures production shows no signs of slowing down. During its second weekend, the feature pulled in staggering numbers internationally and domestically, proving that audience enthusiasm remains at an all-time high. With strong daily grosses still rolling in, trade circles are already speculating about the possibility of the film inching closer to even loftier financial milestones.

Domestic Dominance

In the domestic market, the Rajinikanth vehicle recorded an impressive single-day net collection on its eleventh day, reflecting a robust surge in ticket sales. This latest haul propelled its cumulative domestic net earnings close to the coveted ₹400-crore milestone. Achieving this feat places the project in an elite tier of domestic performers alongside its own predecessor and Vijay's hit movie Leo.

International Reach

Beyond domestic borders, the international appeal of the franchise has proven to be a massive driving force. Overseas territories contributed significantly to the overall tally, accumulating tens of millions in foreign currency and pushing the worldwide gross well past the ₹710-crore mark. This balanced performance across local and global markets underscores the widespread popularity of the lead actor.

Dethroning Previous Records

The journey to the top involved eclipsing several massive titles that previously dominated the upper echelons of Tamil cinema history. Jailer 2 successfully overtook the eight-year-old lifetime record previously held by the science-fiction spectacle 2.0. Along the way, it also surpassed other heavy hitters including Leo, the first part of the franchise, and another recent tentpole release, Coolie.

Exclusive Cinematic Club

By crossing ₹700 crore worldwide, the movie has carved out a unique space in Indian cinema history. It stands proudly as the seventh South Indian film to breach this elite financial tier and marks the eighteenth Indian film overall to enter the exclusive club, further cementing the global footprint of regional language cinema.

Cast and Crew Details

The project marks a notable departure for Rajinikanth, who historically has been hesitant to sign on for sequels to his legendary blockbusters. Reprising his celebrated role as 'Tiger' Muthuvel Pandian, the veteran actor leads a sprawling ensemble cast that blends returning fan favorites with prominent fresh faces. Actors such as Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa, and Rithvik return from the original installment.

Music and Cameos

Adding to the cinematic spectacle are high-profile additions and cameo appearances featuring esteemed names from across Indian cinema, including S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Vidya Balan, Anna Rajan, Jatin Sarna, Hrithik Roshan, Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, and Jackie Shroff. The sonic landscape of the movie, crucial to its high-energy pacing, was crafted by composer Anirudh Ravichander.

ld.articleBody:
Global Milestone Achieved

The epic cinematic adaptation Ramayana: Part 1 has officially powered past the monumental Rs 1,700 crore threshold at the worldwide box office by its nineteenth day in theatres. Even though weekdays typically bring a slowdown in ticket sales, the blockbuster continues to exhibit remarkable staying power globally, driven by strong international markets and enduring audience interest.

With overseas earnings alone contributing Rs 563 crore to the tally, the combined worldwide gross has now touched Rs 1,704.65 crore. This robust international performance demonstrates the wide geographical appeal of the project, allowing it to sustain impressive momentum well into its third week of theatrical release.

The Third Monday Slowdown

Like most commercial releases, the enterprise encountered a notable downward correction on its third Monday, pulling in Rs 12.70 crore in nett collections across all Indian languages. This figure reflects a sharp 64.3 percent reduction compared to the previous day, when the feature had pocketed Rs 35.60 crore on Sunday.

Such weekday dips are standard industry behavior following heavy weekend surges. Nevertheless, the scale of the drop highlights the transition from peak weekend footfalls back to standard weekday viewing habits among patrons across various territories.

Approaching the Domestic Nett Record

Domestically, the movie stands on the verge of creating history as its overall India nett collection climbs to Rs 955.45 crore according to tracking data from Sacnilk. This leaves the production just Rs 44.55 crore away from breaching the coveted Rs 1,000 crore domestic nett milestone.

Concurrently, the film's total India gross has ascended to Rs 1,141.65 crore. Reaching this plateau places the venture in an elite tier of Indian cinema, underscoring the massive scale of domestic ticket sales amassed over its nearly three-week run.

Language-Wise Performance on Day 19

On its nineteenth day, the feature was screened across 15,696 shows nationwide, with the Hindi version spearheading the box office output by generating Rs 9.25 crore from 13,442 shows. Regional versions also added steady contributions to the overall daily ledger.

The Malayalam language variant brought in Rs 1.50 crore across 826 shows, while the Kannada version secured Rs 85 lakh from 438 screenings. Additionally, the Tamil language rollout yielded Rs 80 lakh from 565 shows, and the Telugu version added Rs 30 lakh from 425 shows.

Trajectory from Opening Week Onwards

The journey to these record figures unfolded through consistent weekly performances, beginning with an opening week gross of Rs 675 crore. This was followed by a second week gross of Rs 357.10 crore, establishing a solid foundation for the enterprise.

Entering the third week, daily collections demonstrated pockets of heavy resurgence, noting Rs 18.80 crore on Day 16, Rs 33.05 crore on Day 17, and Rs 42.50 crore on Day 18, before settling at a gross of Rs 15.15 crore on Day 19.

Cast, Crew, and Creative Direction

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari as the initial chapter of a two-part adaptation of the ancient Hindu epic, the project is alternatively known as Ramayana: Rise of a Legend in international regions. The prominent principal cast features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita, and Yash in the role of Ravana.

The supporting ensemble includes Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, Rakul Preet Singh as Surpanakha, Lara Dutta as Queen Kaikeyi, Arun Govil as King Dashrath, and Kajal Aggarwal as Mandodari. Production duties were managed by Namit Malhotra and Yash under Prime Focus Studios and Monster Mind Creations, featuring visual effects by DNEG and ReDefine alongside music composed by Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman.

Sequel Confirmation and Future Plans

The cinematic journey of this epic narrative is far from concluding with the current theatrical exhibition. Producers have officially confirmed that the saga will continue with Ramayana: Part 2.

Audiences can expect the sequel to arrive in theatres during the Diwali festival in 2028, extending the multi-part exploration of the legendary tale.

ld.articleBody:
Stepping Away From Call the Midwife

While the beloved BBC drama Call the Midwife is currently on a pause with no Christmas special in the works, fan-favourite actress Laura Main is keeping busy. Known for playing Shelagh Turner in the hit series, Main has transitioned to the stage for a demanding theatrical schedule.

Describing the experience as the most civilised theatre tour schedule she has ever encountered, Main has embraced the chance to connect directly with live audiences while balancing her television background.

Exploring By Royal Appointment

Main is starring in the UK tour of the play By Royal Appointment, which explores the unique relationship between the late Queen Elizabeth II and her dresser. The character played by Main serves as a loose amalgamation of real-life dressers, most notably Angela Kelly.

The theatrical production delves into how the monarch collaborated with her staff to curate her public image and project specific moods through her wardrobe over the later years of her reign.

Jane Asher as the Monarch

Veteran actress Jane Asher takes on the monumental role of Queen Elizabeth II in the production. Asher has noted that the play depicts the monarch around the age of 46, finding her footing and mastering her royal duties with immense confidence.

The script highlights how the Queen maintained her famous discretion regarding world matters while cleverly using bright colors, black, or muted tones to communicate her inner feelings and reactions to national hardships to her people.

A Different Perspective on Royalty

Written by Daisy Goodwin—the creator of the hit ITV drama Victoria—the play offers a backstage look at the British monarch. Goodwin drew from personal knowledge to craft a narrative that showcases the private moments behind the public facade.

Main pointed out that the audience gets to witness the Queen sharing her vulnerabilities and fears with her dresser, revealing a human side that was never visible to the general public during her lifetime.

Drawing Parallels to Acting

Reflecting on the nature of the role, Laura Main noted that preparing the royal image shares similarities with the craft of acting. She drew a personal comparison to her own fifteen-year tenure on Call the Midwife.

Main explained that putting on a specific costume has a transformative effect, helping both actors and historical figures feel confident and prepared to execute their professional duties.

Tour Schedule and Future Venues

The production of By Royal Appointment is currently touring venues across the United Kingdom and is scheduled to run until 6 February. The show follows an earlier, short run that took place in the summer of 2025.

Upcoming stops on the tour include the York Theatre Royal, His Majesty’s Theatre in Aberdeen, Chichester Festival Theatre, the Edinburgh Kings Theatre, and the Marlowe Theatre in Canterbury.

ld.articleBody:
Day 2 Box Office Growth

The Nayanthara headliner Mookuthi Amman 2 experienced a positive upswing during its second day in theatres, witnessing a 30.3 percent growth in collections compared to its opening day. Despite drawing mixed responses from audiences and critics alike, the sequel managed to pull in Rs 5 crore.

This weekend surge demonstrates sustained audience interest, particularly in regional strongholds, as the fantasy feature continues its theatrical run.

Language-Wise Performance and Occupancy

The Tamil version of the movie continued to comfortably outperform the Telugu version on Saturday. Screenings in Tamil collected Rs 2.30 crore across 1,698 shows, translating to a strong overall theatre occupancy of 32 percent.

In contrast, the Telugu dubbed version recorded an overall occupancy of 29 percent, bringing in Rs 15 lakh from 212 screenings. Overall, the Tamil language screenings accounted for the vast majority of the India nett earnings.

Detailed Tamil Version Occupancy Breakdown

Examining the Tamil 2D format further, the movie registered a cumulative occupancy rate of 29.98 percent through Saturday. Morning screenings started off with 17.46 percent, which improved significantly to 31.46 percent during the afternoon slots.

The momentum continued into the later parts of the day, with evening and night screenings achieving 32.54 percent and 38.46 percent occupancies respectively.

Detailed Telugu Version Occupancy Breakdown

The Telugu version of the fantasy feature registered an overall occupancy of 25.26 percent on its second day. Morning shows opened at 20.44 percent before dipping down to 13.33 percent during afternoon screenings.

Later in the day, audience numbers recovered moderately, with the evening and night shows capturing 20.11 percent and 26.22 percent occupancies respectively.

Regional Markets and Domestic Footprint

Tamil Nadu firmly maintained its position as the primary market for the film on Saturday, generating Rs 2.40 crore which accounted for 84.2 percent of its tracked domestic gross earnings for the day.

Other regions also contributed to the daily total, with Andhra Pradesh and Telangana combining for Rs 20 lakh, Karnataka adding Rs 12 lakh, Kerala contributing Rs 10 lakh, and remaining territories chipping in with Rs 3 lakh.

Box Office Competition and Cast

The sequel's theatrical run is facing stiff competition at the box office from other major titles currently in cinemas, including Suriya's Scene and Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana.

Mookuthi Amman 2 features a robust ensemble cast including Nayanthara, Regina Cassandra, Duniya Vijay, Urvashi, Yogi Babu, Myna Nandini, Garuda Ram, Abhinaya, and Shruthy S.

Director Addresses CGI Criticism

Amid viewer debates and online discussions regarding the film's computer-generated imagery and visual effects—with some critics comparing them to AI-generated graphics—director Sundar C has spoken out.

At a pre-release event, the filmmaker expressed disappointment over hasty criticisms made without acknowledging the immense labor involved, revealing that nearly 400 Tamil technicians spent about a year and a half working on the CGI.

Nayanthara's fantasy sequel Mookuthi Amman 2 achieved a 30.3 percent increase in collections on its second day, earning Rs 5 crore despite mixed reviews and heavy competition from other theatrical releases. The Tamil version heavily dominated regional earnings compared to the Telugu version, with Tamil Nadu serving as the primary domestic market.

Director Sundar C also defended the film's visual effects against online criticism, emphasizing the extensive manpower and time invested by hundreds of technicians to bring the project to life.

Exploring Underrated Period Dramas

Period dramas encompass a vast array of television storytelling, ranging from sweeping historical romances to intense wartime chronicles. This diverse genre offers audiences an abundance of choices, yet despite the popularity of several mainstream titles, others manage to slip under the radar. One notable example is Apple TV's psychological period piece that has steadily maintained its reputation among dedicated fans.

Released as a short-form miniseries, the production offers an unpredictable viewing experience within the historical genre. Even years after its initial premiere, it stands out as a compelling watch for enthusiasts looking for rich storytelling and immersive atmospheric depth.

Literary Origins and Creative Team

The television adaptation draws its narrative directly from Sarah Perry's acclaimed novel of the same name. Bringing the intricate literary world to life required a talented ensemble, with celebrated actors Claire Danes and Tom Hiddleston anchoring the production in the lead roles.

Beyond the star power of its central duo, the miniseries distinguishes itself through a deliberate narrative pacing. The tension builds gradually as the plot twists and turns, creating an immersive viewing experience that captivates audiences from beginning to end.

Unraveling the Victorian Gothic Mystery

Set squarely in the Victorian era, the gothic romance centers on Cora Seaborne, portrayed by Claire Danes. Cora is introduced as a newly widowed woman and an avid paleontology enthusiast. Rather than surrendering to conventional mourning following the death of an abusive husband, she embraces her newfound freedom to pursue her scientific passions.

Motivated by local rumors concerning a mythical creature rumored to haunt the village of Aldwinter, Cora packs up her son Frankie and her loyal companion Martha. Traveling directly to the rural settlement, she sets out to investigate the validity of the reported beast.

Skepticism and Complex Local Dynamics

Upon arriving in Aldwinter, Cora discovers that the local residents are utterly convinced the mysterious creature is responsible for a series of tragic local events. However, the village vicar, Will Ransome, maintains a skeptical stance regarding the monster, initiating an intellectual connection with Cora.

As the narrative progresses, a complicated love triangle develops between Cora and Will, complicated further by the fact that Will is married to Stella. Amid mounting disasters and unexplained disappearances, the suspicious villagers eventually begin to target Cora despite her initial intentions to help.

Character-Driven Narrative and Performance Strengths

Ultimately, the core conflict of the series transcends the physical existence of any mythical monster. The primary obstacles stem from the volatile hysteria gripping Aldwinter and the deeply intricate emotional romance unfolding between the central characters.

The stellar performances delivered by the principal cast serve as the anchor of the entire production. The emotional complexity brought by the actors elevates the storytelling, transforming a standard mystery into a profound exploration of layered human relationships.

Subverting Traditional Victorian Heroines

Cora's character challenges the conventional tropes associated with traditional Victorian heroines. Her unwavering dedication to empirical science and her innate skepticism provide a refreshing perspective that drives the momentum of the episodes.

Furthermore, the series addresses her past trauma directly, allowing her to break free from an oppressive marriage and dedicate herself entirely to intellectual exploration and personal autonomy.

A Rewarding Weekend Binge

Consisting of a concise run of episodes, the miniseries provides a satisfying and accessible format for viewers seeking a thrilling weekend watch. Its tight pacing ensures that every installment delivers unexpected developments.

For followers of historical fiction and gothic mysteries who might have missed its initial premiere, the production remains a rewarding recommendation within the streaming landscape.

Ram Gopal Varma Defends Ramayana Part 1 Budget

Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma has stepped forward to champion Nitesh Tiwari's cinematic adaptation of the Indian epic Ramayana. Amid circulating rumors regarding massive production expenses, Varma addressed the financial figures associated with the high-profile venture.

While reports have estimated a combined budget of Rs 4700 crore for both halves, Varma asserted that the first installment actually cost less than Rs 800 crore.

Breaking Down Financial Realities

The outspoken director pointed out that the expenses for the opening chapter factor in global tax benefits, mutually beneficial agreements, and subsidy elements. He noted that these financial adjustments naturally reduce the overall capital required.

Furthermore, Varma criticized assumptions that both parts share identical expenditures, drawing parallels to how climax sequences often consume significantly larger shares of a movie's total budget.

Additional Revenue Streams and Co-Producer Plans

Highlighting the commercial strategy mapped out by co-producer Namit Malhotra, Varma emphasized that theatrical ticket sales are only one component of the venture's financial model.

The rollout of merchandise, theme parks, and gaming properties are designed to act as lucrative auxiliary revenue streams that will bolster the overall profitability of the enterprise.

Recovery Prospects for the Epic

Given the strong momentum at the global box office, Varma expressed confidence that the opening chapter will generate enough revenue to cover the financial commitments of both films combined.

He suggested that non-theatrical revenues and future inflows from the upcoming sequel will leave the production team with substantial financial surplus.

High Praise for Namit Malhotra

The director didn't hold back in his admiration for co-producer Namit Malhotra, comparing his industry impact to foundational milestones in Indian cinema.

Varma went as far as calling Malhotra a transformative figure in Hindi cinema history, referencing Dadasaheb Phalke's silent film Raja Harishchandra released over a century ago.

Lofty Predictions for Ramayana 2

Looking ahead to the sequel scheduled for 2028, Varma offered an ambitious projection regarding its commercial performance compared to the debut film.

Drawing a comparison to Prashanth Neel's action franchise, he noted that if KGF Chapter 2 outperformed its predecessor by five times, the upcoming mythological sequel could potentially multiply those earnings tenfold.

Box Office Milestone and Personal Connection

The mythological feature has already achieved significant milestones, crossing the Rs 1288 crore mark worldwide within its first ten days in cinemas following its release three days prior to Diwali.

Demonstrating the wide demographic reach of the film, Varma shared a personal anecdote about his mother purchasing tickets for building staff, a gesture she never extended to his own directorial projects.

ld.articleBody:
Backstage Meeting Goes Viral

A heartwarming interaction between Punjabi music star Diljit Dosanjh and Rosa Rodriguez, mother of reggaeton artist Daddy Yankee, has taken social media by storm. The meeting occurred backstage at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas during the 2026 Latin Grammy Awards. As Daddy Yankee introduced the two, Diljit immediately bent down to touch Rosa Rodriguez's feet in a traditional display of respect.

Rosa appeared pleasantly surprised by the gesture, reacting with a soft smile and placing her hand on her chest. Meanwhile, Daddy Yankee looked on happily, cheering as they greeted one another. The clip has since circulated widely across various digital platforms, capturing the imagination of international and domestic fans alike.

Global Stage Meets Traditional Values

Observers and fans on social media were quick to praise the singer for staying true to his cultural roots despite achieving massive global fame. One user on X highlighted the moment as an exhibition of pure Punjabi values on an international platform, noting that traditional respect remains untouched regardless of stardom.

Commentators lauded the humility displayed during the encounter, pointing out how the artist seamlessly integrated his upbringing into a high-profile Western event. The video quickly transformed into a major talking point across the internet, cementing its place as one of the most talked-about moments of the night.

Historic Performance With Daddy Yankee

The interaction followed a landmark evening for the Indian musician at the 27th Latin Grammy Awards held on November 12. Diljit made history at the ceremony by becoming the first Indian artist to ever perform live on the prestigious stage. He joined Daddy Yankee to deliver a live rendition of Pokito, their collaborative bilingual track fusing Punjabi and Latin rhythms.

Following the event, the artist took to social media to express his gratitude to his collaborator and the Latin Recording Academy. He celebrated the merging of two distinct musical cultures on a single platform, sharing his excitement with his followers online.

Upcoming Global Appearances

Beyond his historic Latin Grammys appearance, the performer is preparing for more major international stages. He is officially scheduled to return to Coachella in 2027, with performances lined up for April 9 and April 16. This follows his landmark debut appearance at the festival back in 2023.

At Coachella 2027, he will share space on the lineup with a star-studded roster of international acts including Dua Lipa, Madonna, JISOO, Zara Larsson, and Steve Lacy, further expanding his global footprint.

Ongoing Aura India Tour 2026

Domestically, the singer is in the midst of a massive concert run across the country. His Aura India Tour 2026 kicked off in Delhi on October 30 to packed arenas and immense fan enthusiasm.

The tour continues to sweep through multiple cities, with his next performance scheduled to take place in Indore on November 15, keeping him busy between international milestones.

ld.articleBody:
Reaching Historic Milestones

The theatrical run of the epic motion picture 'Ramayana' has achieved a monumental milestone by officially surpassing the Rs 1,000 crore mark in the domestic market within just two weeks of release. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, the feature has quickly established itself as a massive commercial success.

Tracking data from Sacnilk confirms that the big-budget production has entered an elite domestic category. This accomplishment establishes the feature as the sixth Indian film overall and the third Hindi-language production to enter the coveted Rs 1,000 crore domestic gross club.

Star-Studded Cast Contributions

The project brings together prominent cinematic figures, featuring performances by Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi. Their combined star power has driven unprecedented ticket sales across multiple regions and languages since opening day.

For lead actors Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi, this milestone represents their first career entry into the Rs 1,000 crore India gross club. Meanwhile, co-star Yash adds a second title to his personal box office record following his previous blockbuster success.

Breakdown of Day 14 Collections

On its fourteenth day in theaters, the feature pulled in an estimated Rs 23.20 crore net across 22,289 shows nationwide. This single-day figure represents an 18.9% decline compared to its Day 13 performance of Rs 28.60 crore net.

The latest earnings push the total domestic net collection to an impressive Rs 844.40 crore. Concurrently, the cumulative domestic gross collection has climbed to an estimated Rs 1,009.05 crore.

Multilingual Market Performance

Language-wise earnings on the second Thursday show strong support from Hindi audiences, which contributed Rs 16.50 crore across 17,661 shows. Regional versions also maintained steady numbers during the mid-week run.

The Malayalam version added an estimated Rs 2.15 crore from 1,051 shows, while the Kannada dubbed version brought in Rs 1.65 crore across 897 shows. Additionally, the Tamil and Telugu versions contributed Rs 1.60 crore and Rs 1.30 crore respectively.

Global Box Office Domination

International markets continue to show robust demand, with the overseas territories contributing an estimated Rs 8 crore on Day 14. This brings the total overseas gross collection to an impressive Rs 510 crore.

Combined with domestic figures, the worldwide gross collection has officially reached a staggering total of Rs 1,519.05 crore. Industry reports note that the feature crossed this global threshold faster than any comparable title in cinematic history.

Exclusive Industry Club Membership

Entering the Rs 1,000 crore club places the production alongside elite historical blockbusters. Comparable titles on this exclusive roster include 'Baahubali 2', 'KGF: Chapter 2', 'Pushpa 2: The Rule', and the 'Dhurandhar' franchise.

As only the third Bollywood movie to achieve this feat, it follows in the footsteps of the 'Dhurandhar' films. The historic run cements the creative team's vision and demonstrates sustained audience enthusiasm.

ld.articleBody:
Title Announcement Triggers Fresh Controversy

The announcement of a new action project titled Sandiyar has plunged actor Kamal Haasan into a renewed social and political controversy. Unveiled on his birthday alongside a striking first-look poster, the film immediately captured public attention for more reasons than one. By choosing to revive this specific name, the production has resurrected a heated debate that first made headlines two decades ago.

The choice of nomenclature has once again placed the spotlight on caste-related connotations in Tamil Nadu cinema. Political figures and critics have quickly mobilized against the decision, arguing that the banner carries historical baggage linked to social tensions. As the project moves forward under the direction of SU Arun Kumar, the title remains a central point of contention.

Understanding the Meaning and Objections

The term Sandiyar generally translates to a street fighter, troublemaker, or rogue within local contexts. Over time, the phrase has also become closely associated with dominant-caste strongmen and caste-based rowdyism in the region. Critics and community leaders argue that using such a label for mainstream entertainment risks glorifying aggressive identity politics.

Dr K Krishnasamy, the founder of the Puthiya Tamilagam Party, has voiced strong objections to the revival of the title. Labeling the decision an act of arrogance and revenge, Krishnasamy publicly questioned why the actor chose to bring back a moniker that had previously caused widespread community distress and opposition.

Echoes of the 2004 Virumaandi Dispute

This is not the first time a project featuring Kamal Haasan has faced resistance over this vocabulary. Back in 2004, the star initially named his venture Virumaandi Sandiyar, which instantly drew severe criticism from Krishnasamy and various social groups. Opponents at the time argued that the phrasing endorsed the dominance of powerful factions.

The initial dispute was further intensified by promotional material, notably a poster featuring the lead actor holding a sickle. Public outcry suggested that the visual presentation combined with the nomenclature could be interpreted as an endorsement of caste-based aggression, forcing the makers to reconsider their branding two decades ago.

Political Intervention and Past Resolution

During the original 2004 dispute, the situation escalated to a point where political intervention was sought. Kamal Haasan attempted to secure backing from the then Chief Minister, J Jayalalithaa, to protect the production and retain the original title against mounting protests.

However, the government ultimately did not extend special protection to the team, recognizing the sensitive nature of the issue. To appease critics and prevent further social friction, the team dropped the contentious suffix, releasing the final product simply under the title Virumaandi.

Warnings and Potential Repercussions

The current decision to reuse the banned terminology has reignited fears of social unrest in regions where caste identity and related violence remain highly sensitive subjects. Detractors worry that the controversy could disrupt ongoing production schedules and deepen community divides across the state.

Adding to the gravity of the situation, Krishnasamy issued a stern warning during his media interactions. He cautioned that if the production stubbornly retains the contested title, the actor could face hostile conditions requiring him to leave Tamil Nadu frequently.

Project Background and Collaborations

Apart from the ongoing naming dispute, Sandiyar marks a significant creative partnership as the first collaboration between Kamal Haasan and filmmaker SU Arun Kumar. The director has previously helmed acclaimed projects such as Chithha and Veera Dheera Sooran, building anticipation for the upcoming actioner.

While further details regarding the supporting cast and overall plot remain under wraps, the actor's schedule is exceptionally busy. Alongside this venture, he is tied to several high-profile undertakings, including the sequel to Kalki 2898 AD, KH X RK, and Indian 3.

ld.articleBody:
An Emotional Gathering for Appa Kutty

The pre-release promotional event for the upcoming Tamil film Appa Kutty served as a deeply significant moment for actor and composer Vijay Antony and his family. The gathering brought together the cast and crew to discuss the upcoming feature, but it quickly became an emotional space for personal reflections.

Joining Vijay Antony at the gathering was his wife Fatima Antony and their younger daughter Laura. The presence of the family added a poignant atmosphere to the proceedings as they prepared to share details about the new cinematic project.

Fatima Antony Breaks Five-Year Hiatus

While addressing the audience at the event, Fatima Antony revealed that she was stepping out for a public cinema function for the first time in five years. She noted that she had avoided attending such entertainment industry gatherings ever since the tragic passing of their elder daughter, Meera.

Her return to a public entertainment platform underscored the profound personal weight of the occasion. The family's openness about their ongoing journey resonated deeply with everyone present at the venue.

The Story Behind Vijay Antony Going Barefoot

One of the most striking personal details shared during the event concerned Vijay Antony's distinctive lifestyle choice of walking entirely without shoes or slippers. Fatima explained that this decision stems directly from memories of their late daughter Meera.

According to Fatima, the family had accumulated a large collection of footwear purchased for Meera, leaving an entire room filled with her shoes and slippers. Confronted daily by these belongings, Vijay Antony resolved to forgo wearing footwear himself, making exceptions only for major stage shows.

A Cherished Watch Keeps Memory Alive

In addition to his barefoot routine, Fatima highlighted another touching daily tribute that Vijay Antony maintains in honor of Meera. Despite owning several high-end luxury timepieces, the actor consistently opts to wear a simple, inexpensive watch.

Sandeep Reddy Vanga Shares His Review

Filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga has shared his enthusiastic review of Nitesh Tiwari's newly released mythological epic, Ramayana. Taking to social media, Vanga posted a direct message encouraging audiences to head to theaters to experience the grand scale of the project.

In his review, the director highlighted the commanding presence of the principal cast members, noting that the lead actors delivered intense portrayals that left a deep impression on him.

Praise For Ranbir Kapoor And Yash

Vanga specifically singled out Ranbir Kapoor and Yash for their work in the film, stating that both actors completely nailed their respective roles. According to the filmmaker, their performances provided an undeniable sense of magnitude to the characters of Ram and Raavana.

The director also acknowledged the dedication behind the production, offering special praise to the producer's commitment to bringing such a massive vision to life on the global stage.

Ramayana has drawn widespread acclaim across the entertainment industry following its theatrical premiere. A number of prominent figures, including Karan Johar, Allu Arjun, Vijay Deverakonda, and Atlee, have shared appreciation posts celebrating the release of Nitesh Tiwari's directorial venture.

Social media platforms have been flooded with positive audience reactions and critical praise, marking the worldwide arrival of the mythological project as a major cultural event for cinema-goers.

Among the prominent voices wishing success to the team was Animal star Rashmika Mandanna, who posted a detailed note on Thursday. She expressed excitement to watch Ranbir Kapoor step into the role of Lord Rama and sent virtual warmth to Sai Pallavi for her portrayal of Sita.

Mandanna also shared her anticipation for Yash's performance as Ravana, while extending her best wishes to director Nitesh Tiwari, music composer A.R. Rahman, producer Namit Malhotra, and the rest of the cast and crew.

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana features a sprawling ensemble cast. Alongside Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, the mythological epic includes pivotal performances by Ravie Dubey, Lara Dutta, Arun Govil, and Kunal Kapoor.

The ambitious production brings together noted creative forces, with A.R. Rahman handling the music and Namit Malhotra producing, aiming to translate a timeless narrative into a magnificent cinematic experience.

The mythological epic has generated immense buzz prior to and during its launch, translating into strong early commercial results. As anticipated by trade analysts, the feature secured a bumper opening at the box office upon its worldwide theatrical debut.

The high-profile release continues to draw massive crowds to theaters globally, aided by the steady stream of positive word-of-mouth from industry colleagues and fans alike.

ld.articleBody:
An Actor-Director Collaboration

Mel Gibson has directed six feature films and appeared in over sixty movies throughout his acclaimed career, earning an Oscar for historical war drama direction. His professional and personal partnership with Mark Wahlberg has grown through multiple projects over the years, showcasing a strong mutual artistic respect.

Their working relationship commenced when they portrayed father and son in a holiday comedy project. They reunited for a faith-based biographical drama before joining forces once again for a tense 2025 action thriller project.

A Rare Villainous Turn

Mark Wahlberg is widely recognized for portraying heroic protagonists and everyday working-class characters on screen. Taking on a full antagonist role remains a rare occurrence in his filmography, echoing his memorable early career performance in a 1996 psychological thriller.

In the 2025 action feature, he steps into the shoes of a deceptive hitman disguised as a chatty pilot from Texas. To embody the sinister character completely, the actor shaved his head instead of using a bald cap and maintained his intense persona throughout the entire production schedule.

Claustrophobic Settings and Plot

The narrative unfolds almost entirely within the cramped confines of a small aircraft flying over the Alaskan wilderness. Michelle Dockery portrays a U.S. Marshal tasked with transporting a fugitive played by Topher Grace, while the disguised pilot reveals his dangerous intentions.

The compact runtime and tense single-location environment provide viewers with a brisk, suspenseful experience. Despite certain predictable story beats, the claustrophobic atmosphere keeps action enthusiasts engaged from start to finish.

Box Office and Critical Reception

Despite debuting at the top spot during its opening weekend in the United States, the movie faced challenges at the box office. It accumulated a worldwide total of forty-eight million seven hundred thousand dollars against a production budget of twenty-five million dollars.

Critics offered mixed-to-negative reviews, reflected in its low Rotten Tomatoes critical score. Reviewers expressed varying opinions regarding the script and direction, though general audiences responded more favorably to the picture.

Departure From Streaming Services

The action thriller originally arrived on HBO Max in November of the previous year. Following a standard twelve-month licensing window, the title is scheduled to leave the platform before the end of the month.

Subscribers wishing to experience the unusual antagonist performance must stream the feature before its removal date. Afterwards, the movie will transition to digital rental and purchase storefronts.

Future Projects for the Duo

Mel Gibson is currently occupied with post-production duties for an upcoming religious epic scheduled to release in parts, alongside plans to helm the final installment of a popular police action franchise. Meanwhile, Mark Wahlberg recently appeared in a crime thriller and is attached to an upcoming Netflix project directed by Baltasar Kormákur.

While neither creator is currently collaborating on a new joint venture, both have indicated openness to future partnerships if the right script presents itself.

The collaborative action thriller starring Mark Wahlberg and directed by Mel Gibson is officially departing from HBO Max this month following a one-year licensing window. Although the feature experienced modest box office returns and divided critical opinions upon its release, it remains notable for Wahlberg's rare villainous performance.

ld.articleBody:
The Financial Settlement

Recent court documents have revealed that actress Jessica Alba has been directed to pay her ex-husband, Cash Warren, an exact total of $577,481. This monetary obligation stems directly from her retirement benefits tied to the profit-sharing plan of her enterprise, HonorBar Inc.

According to the official records, this figure will undergo adjustments based on investment gains and losses leading right up to the final date of the fund transfer. Once this specific obligation is met, Alba will have no further requirements to disburse additional company-related benefits to Warren.

Prior Asset Distribution

This latest court-mandated payment follows a previous financial arrangement designed to balance asset distribution when the former couple officially settled their divorce in February. At that time, Warren received a substantial $3 million payout.

Reports noted that that earlier sum was divided into two distinct installments of $1.5 million each. Interestingly, despite managing considerable business ventures—including Alba's Honest Company valued at $623 million and Warren's brand Pair of Thieves valued at least $100 million—the pair had never signed a prenuptial agreement.

Marriage and Separation Timeline

The financial proceedings mark the ongoing conclusion of a long-term relationship that spanned nearly two decades. Alba and Warren were married for 16 years before ultimately deciding to separate in December 2024.

Following their private separation, the actress publicly addressed the split on social media in January 2025. She noted her pride in their mutual growth over 20 years and expressed a desire to move forward into a new chapter of individual evolution.

Filing for Divorce

Shortly after addressing the public regarding their separation, formal legal proceedings commenced. Alba filed for divorce in early 2025, officially citing irreconcilable differences as the underlying reason for the termination of the marriage.

Throughout the transition, both individuals emphasized mutual respect and a dedication to their shared history. Alba stressed that they would forever remain a family and that their primary focus would always stay on their children.

Custody and Family Life

The former couple shares three children together: daughters Honor, aged 18, and Haven, aged 15, alongside an eight-year-old son named Hayes. Following their split, both parents maintained shared responsibilities for their offspring.

Alba and Warren currently share joint legal and physical custody of all three children. Despite the ongoing legal resolutions regarding their assets and finances, the co-parents have continued to navigate their family duties.

Post-Divorce Romance and Public Dynamics

In the time since their separation, both individuals have experienced shifts in their personal lives. Alba has been linked romantically to actor Danny Ramirez since July 2025, with the pair frequently spotted together, including a romantic Florida getaway in May.

Meanwhile, public interactions between the former spouses have occasionally appeared strained. The two experienced an awkward reunion in May while attending their daughter Honor's high school graduation in Los Angeles, where they consciously sat on opposite ends of the same row.

ld.articleBody:
The Controversy Begins

Prominent Bollywood stunt coordinator and body double Geeta Tandon recently brought public attention to an unpleasant experience she faced during a shoot. The industry professional took to social media to voice her grievances regarding how she and her son were treated behind the scenes of a high-profile television production.

The incident centers around the television project hosted by renowned actor Anil Kapoor. Tandon detailed her grievances online, emphasizing that basic human decency should never be compromised regardless of a person's standing within the entertainment business.

Details Of The Long Wait

According to Tandon's public statement, she arrived at the designated shooting location at approximately 12:30 pm. The production team had assured her that her scheduled segment would be recorded after a brief passage of time, but this initial estimate stretched into a nearly all-day ordeal.

She noted that she and her son were confined to a tent for the duration of the delay without receiving any clear updates. Tandon had rearranged her own professional timetable and had even arranged for her son to travel back from Goa specifically to participate in the filming.

Interactions With Production

As the hours ticked by without progress, Tandon attempted to communicate with the crew members to find out when their work would begin. Instead of receiving transparency, she reported being brushed off repeatedly by staff who offered no concrete timeline for the shoot.

The situation escalated when she directly questioned a production manager named Jaydeep about the poor communication and prolonged confinement. According to her account, the response from the production side was dismissive, telling them they could leave only if they signed certain documents first.

Departure And Public Stance

Finding the attitude of the production crew unacceptable, Tandon and her son ultimately decided to walk away from the set at 9:15 pm. They had spent nearly nine hours waiting without receiving the courtesy of timely updates or basic hospitality.

In her social media post, she stressed that she had attended purely by invitation and had not requested any financial favors or special treatment. Her primary demand was simple professional courtesy and human dignity for everyone involved in media productions.

Reactions From Anil Kapoor And Farah Khan

Following the widespread attention generated by Tandon's post, key figures associated with the production stepped forward to address the matter. Host Anil Kapoor responded in the comment section to express sincere regret over the oversight during his show.

Filmmaker Farah Khan, who appeared as a guest on that particular episode, also offered an apology. Khan explained that she had been shooting for a different segment in the evening and would gladly have accommodated Tandon in her vanity van had she been aware of the situation.

Stunt director Geeta Tandon publicly criticized the production team of Anil Kapoor's show after enduring a nine-hour wait alongside her son on set. Following her social media post detailing the disrespectful treatment, both host Anil Kapoor and guest Farah Khan issued public apologies.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to Raising The Cannons

A forthcoming documentary project on Netflix is set to spotlight the expansive and complex family life of media personality and host Nick Cannon. Titled Raising The Cannons, the upcoming series offers an unfiltered look into his bustling existence as a father to twelve children shared with six different mothers.

The show aims to move past public headlines to examine how Cannon balances a busy entertainment career, health challenges, and his extensive blended family dynamic. Scheduled to premiere on December 18, 2026, the program features intimate access to several members of his household.

Candid Comments From the Eldest Twins

Among the most striking moments in the newly released promotional trailer involves Nick's fifteen-year-old twins, Moroccan and Monroe, whom he shares with music icon Mariah Carey. While riding in a car with her father, Monroe delivers a blunt and emotional observation, telling him that he and Mariah would have reunited if he did not have so many children.

Later in the footage, Moroccan weighs in on the family setup as well, expressing his perspective that the fast-paced and crowded lifestyle is not sustainable. Their rare on-camera statements provide a glimpse into the emotional realities of growing up within such a uniquely structured household.

Divorce History and Past Regrets

The relationship between Nick and Mariah has long been a subject of public interest since their marriage came to an end. The pair separated in 2014, and their formal divorce proceedings were concluded in 2016.

Within the documentary trailer, Nick reflects on the breakup, acknowledging that his own ego pushed Mariah away. He has previously noted that disparities in their respective levels of fame and financial success played a major role in his decision to initiate the separation.

Reflecting on a Trauma Response

In earlier remarks made during a 2025 appearance on The Breakfast Club, Cannon opened up about the rapid arrival of his numerous children. He characterized the period as a carelessness rooted in a trauma response rather than deliberate acting out.

He admitted that having access to substantial financial resources allowed him to move through life without adequate pause. Looking back, he expressed that taking time for inner work and deeper consideration might have altered the course of several scenarios.

The Larger Family and Participating Mothers

Beyond Moroccan and Monroe, Nick is father to a large group of children with various partners. His sons include Golden Sagon, Rise Messiah, twins Zion Mixolydian and Zillion Heir, and Legendary Love, while his daughters consist of Powerful Queen, Beautiful Zeppelin, Onyx Ice, and Halo Marie. Tragically, his infant son Zen passed away at five months old in 2021.

Out of the six mothers connected to his children, four are participating in the Netflix production: Abby De La Rosa, Alyssa Scott, Bre Tiesi, and LaNisha Cole. Mariah Carey and Brittany Bell chosen not to take part in the series.

Background on Brittany Bell

Brittany Bell, who shares children with Cannon, recently achieved a significant academic milestone outside of the entertainment sphere. The former model and Miss USA 2010 contestant for Arizona earned a doctorate in psychology in 2026.

Her doctoral dissertation focused on fathers with children across multiple women, exploring identity development and the psychological impact of paternal involvement on kids. She noted that having her children present for that milestone made the accomplishment deeply meaningful.

Nick Cannon's upcoming Netflix documentary Raising The Cannons features emotional commentary from his fifteen-year-old twins with Mariah Carey regarding their parents' past split and the family's expansive lifestyle. The series explores his journey raising twelve children with multiple mothers while addressing past relationship regrets and personal growth.

As a variety of films draw younger demographics into cinemas, a counter-programming choice aimed at older audiences has emerged as a major theatrical performer. Spending over a month on the big screen, the survival thriller has successfully navigated intense competition from multiple directions.

The new survival project pairs the seasoned actor with a director who has also experienced a strong wave of career success and audience favor.

Reuniting With David Ayer

The thriller marks a reunion between Pitt and filmmaker David Ayer, who previously collaborated on the war drama Fury. Ayer has recently enjoyed a strong streak in the commercial action sphere.

The director rebuilt his standing within major Hollywood studios through a pair of successful action vehicles starring Jason Statham. Both The Beekeeper and A Working Man established Ayer as a dependable crowd-pleaser.

Ayer's recent Jason Statham projects earned widespread appreciation from ticket buyers for their direct, unpretentious action delivery. However, his latest venture alongside Brad Pitt has managed to surpass those prior titles in scale and audience reach.
